purpose: Fast Planetary OS teaching-target index. Unknown targets fall back to the complete compact browser index.

scope.name: Confirmed exoplanets in the Solar neighbourhood plus named teaching systems
scope.note: The Local Group is a group of galaxies. This snapshot covers nearby Milky Way planetary systems and the explicitly included teaching targets.

updatePolicy.method: Build-time/server-side NASA Exoplanet Archive TAP snapshot
updatePolicy.runtimeNetwork: Production browsers read only this same-origin JSON file and do not query NASA TAP directly.
updatePolicy.fallback: A failed, empty, or schema-invalid refresh must not overwrite the checked-in or already-copied snapshot.
updatePolicy.compositionPolicy: The TAP spectra table exposes spectrum metadata, not a vetted species-detection catalogue. No atmospheric species are parsed from notes or inferred.

sources.name: NASA Exoplanet Archive Planetary Systems default parameter sets
NASA Exoplanet Archive Planetary Systems Composite Parameters
NASA Exoplanet Archive Atmospheric Spectroscopy metadata
